001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.controller;
002
003import android.os.Bundle;
004import android.view.LayoutInflater;
005import android.view.View;
006import android.view.ViewGroup;
007import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
008import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
009import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment;
010import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner;
011import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelProvider;
012import androidx.navigation.Navigation;
013import com.google.android.gms.auth.api.signin.GoogleSignInAccount;
014import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint;
015import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
016import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel.LoginViewModel;
017
018/**
019 * A Fragment that represents the pre-login state for the application.
020 * It observes the user's Google Sign-In account status and handles navigation
021 * to appropriate fragments based on the account state.
022 *
023 * This fragment initializes by setting up a ViewModel to monitor the account
024 * and throwable states for possible sign-in errors or account changes.
025 */
026@AndroidEntryPoint
027public class PreLoginFragment extends Fragment {
028
029  private View root;
030
031  @Nullable
032  @Override
033  public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container,
034      @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
035    root = inflater.inflate(R.layout.fragment_pre_login, container, false);
036    return root;
037  }
038
039  @Override
040  public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
041    super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
042    LoginViewModel viewModel = new ViewModelProvider(requireActivity())
043        .get(LoginViewModel.class);
044    LifecycleOwner owner = getViewLifecycleOwner();
045    viewModel
046        .getAccount()
047        .observe(owner, this::handleAccount);
048    viewModel
049        .getRefreshThrowable()
050        .observe(owner, this::handleThrowable);
051    viewModel.refresh();
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Handles the user's Google Sign-In account. If the account is not null,
056   * it navigates the user to the HomeFragment.
057   *
058   * @param account the GoogleSignInAccount instance representing the user's
059   *                signed-in Google account, or null if no account is signed in
060   */
061  private void handleAccount(GoogleSignInAccount account) {
062    if (account != null) {
063      Navigation.findNavController(root)
064          .navigate(PreLoginFragmentDirections.navigateToHomeFragment());
065    }
066  }
067
068  /**
069   * Handles throwable errors that may occur during the account refresh process.
070   * If a throwable is not null, it navigates the user to the LoginFragment to
071   * handle the error scenario.
072   *
073   * @param throwable the Throwable instance representing the error encountered,
074   *                  or null if no error occurred
075   */
076  private void handleThrowable(Throwable throwable) {
077    if (throwable != null) {
078      Navigation.findNavController(root)
079          .navigate(PreLoginFragmentDirections.navigateToLoginFragment());
080    }
081  }
082
083}
